subject: english
question:
Choose the sentence that uses a homonym of the underlined word:

The __lead __pipes were replaced due to safety concerns.

options.text: The general will lead the troops into battle.
​Exposure to lead can cause health issues in children.
The old house still had lead in its plumbing system.
They tested the soil for traces of lead.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lead"** in the sentence refers to the metal "lead," which is a heavy, toxic element used in plumbing and other applications. (सीसा)

 
 
• **Example:** The old house still had lead pipes, which posed a health hazard.
 
 
 
• In Option 1, the word "lead" is a homonym, meaning it is spelled the same but has a different meaning. Here, "lead" refers to guiding or directing, such as leading troops into battle. (नेतृत्व करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The captain will lead his team to victory in the tournament.
 
 
 
• Homonyms are words that are spelled or pronounced the same but have different meanings. In this case, "lead" as a metal and "lead" as guiding are homonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Exposure to lead can cause health issues in children. (सीसा)

 
 
• **Example:** Lead poisoning is a serious issue in areas with old plumbing systems.
 
 This uses "lead" as the toxic metal and does not involve a homonym.
 
• **Option 3:** The old house still had lead in its plumbing system. (सीसा)
 
 
• **Example:** The government recommends replacing lead pipes to prevent contamination.
 
 This option repeats the meaning of "lead" as a metal and does not involve a homonym.
 
• **Option 4:** They tested the soil for traces of lead. (सीसा)
 
 
• **Example:** High levels of lead in the soil can harm crops and groundwater.
 
 This again refers to "lead" as the toxic metal.
